name: Electronics Toolkit
description: A professional responsive website for ECE and electronics students, hobbyists, and beginners featuring real-time Resistor Color Code, Ohm's Law, LED Resistor, and Unit Conversion calculators with light and dark mode.
tools: Ohm's Law Calculator (V, I, R Solver)
Electronics Unit Converter (Resistance, Voltage, Current, Power)
features: Interactive 4-band and 5-band resistor color decoding with visual SVG resistor preview
Ohm's Law solver with unit multipliers, interactive triangle diagram, and step-by-step formula explanations
LED resistor calculator with LED color presets, standard E12 commercial snapping, power dissipation, and wattage safety ratings
Live bidirectional electronics unit converter for Resistance, Voltage, Current, and Power with scientific notation
Full responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Toggleable Light and Dark mode with persistence
Vercel-ready modern web stack using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
